description: Implementation of OrderService handling order creation, listing, detail retrieval, cancellation, and payment processing in an e-commerce backend.

classes.name: OrderServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of OrderService handling order operations in an e-commerce system.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order based on shipping ID and user ID, including inventory checks, order item creation, and cart updates.

methods.name: orderList
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of orders for a user, including order items and shipping info.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Fetches detailed information of a specific order for a user.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an order and restores inventory.

methods.name: paymentOrder
methods.description: Processes payment for an order after verifying a code.

methods.name: preCheckOrder
methods.description: Checks if an order is valid for further processing.

methods.name: buildShipping
methods.description: Constructs a Shipping object from an Order.

methods.name: buildOrderVo
methods.description: Builds an OrderVo object from order, order items, and shipping info.

methods.name: buildOrder
methods.description: Constructs an Order object from order items, shipping, user ID, and order number.

methods.name: buildShippingVo
methods.description: Creates a ShippingVo from a Shipping object.

methods.name: buildOrderItem
methods.description: Creates an OrderItem from product, quantity, order number, and user ID.
